name: Get processing details
description: Call this when you need to retrieve the current processing status, pending counts, and rate limits of the automation engine. Use automation.get_meta_info instead if you only need high‑level automation information.

processingStatus.description: Overall health status of the automation processing engine.

pendingActionsCount.description: Number of actions waiting to be processed.

pendingEventsCount.description: Number of events waiting to be processed.

pendingTriggersCount.description: Number of triggers waiting to be processed.

actionsRateLimit.description: Maximum number of actions that can be processed per second.

eventsRateLimit.description: Maximum number of events that can be processed per second.
